local_graphics.measurement: symbol graphics only; excludes pins, properties, and text

placed_graphics.measurement: axis-aligned bounds after schematic placement, rotation, and mirroring

placed.measurement: pad bounds after footprint placement and rotation

mounting_holes.classification_reason: plated pad uses a mechanical mounting/shield identifier
mounting_holes.name: Mounting Hole 4.25 mm Round Plated

pads_local.measurement: all footprint pads in footprint-local coordinates

pads_placed.measurement: all pads after PCB placement and rotation

courtyard_local.measurement: F.CrtYd and B.CrtYd graphics; text excluded

courtyard_placed.measurement: courtyard after PCB placement and rotation

fabrication_local.measurement: F.Fab and B.Fab graphics; text excluded

silkscreen_local.measurement: F.SilkS and B.SilkS graphics; text excluded

overall_local.measurement: all non-text footprint graphics and pads

overall_placed.measurement: all non-text footprint graphics and pads after placement

connectivity_cross_check.policy: Named schematic nets are compared with PCB pad nets using matching pin/pad numbers; root-sheet local labels also allow KiCad's leading '/' prefix.
